mapper.insert: INSERT INTO calendar_members (calendar_id, user_id, role, status) VALUES (#{calendarId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM calendar_members WHERE calendar_id = #{calendarId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND role = 'owner' AND status = 'accepted'
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM calendar_members WHERE calendar_id = #{calendarId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'accepted'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM calendar_members WHERE calendar_id = #{calendarId} AND status = 'accepted'

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.name AS name, cm.role AS role, cm.joined_at AS joinedAt FROM calendar_members cm JOIN users u ON u.id = cm.user_id WHERE cm.calendar_id = #{calendarId} AND cm.status = 'accepted' ORDER BY (cm.role = 'owner') DESC, cm.joined_at ASC, u.id ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM calendar_members WHERE calendar_id = #{calendarId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND role = 'member'
